name: Courtesan
description: You worked professionally as a companion, rising from dockside work to guild recognition.

features.level3: Guild Contacts & Houses of Ill Repute

traits: I can find something beautiful in everyone.
Every conversation is a performance, and I am always on stage.
I never forget a face—or any body part.
I prefer innuendo to open communication.
My laughter is a shield and refuge.
I collect secrets the way others collect coin.
I am generous to those who please me and merciless to those who don't.

ideals.text: Power. Desire is the true currency of the world.
Beauty. Life is too short for anything less than exquisite.
Sisterhood. Every harlot is kin to me, and I protect my own.
Pleasure. The pursuit of ecstasy is the highest calling.
Redemption. Even the coldest heart can be warmed by the right touch.

bonds: I owe my life to the madam who bought my contract.
A powerful noble keeps my true name in a locked box; I will do anything to retrieve it.
My family needs every coin I earn, and I work hard to support them.
I am secretly in love with a client who can never return my feelings.
I owe the guild too much, and I will be working off my debt until I die.
I seek the one patron who saw the real me beneath the paint and perfume.
flaws: I fall in love far too easily.
I can't resist a dangerous liaison.
My pride will not let me accept charity, even when I'm starving.
I keep trophies from every lover; some are dangerous to possess.
I am addicted to the thrill of being desired.
